kinds.label: Web search
kinds.note: Searching sends the agent's query to Brave Search.

kinds.label: Site
kinds.note: Search for a domain or paste an address to add it. An agent can send information to any site it may read, in the addresses it opens, so allow only sites you trust. A block on a domain wins over access to a wider one.

operations.name: search
operations.title: Search the web
operations.description: Search the web. Returns titles, addresses and short snippets, not page contents. To get more results, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor.

operations.name: read_page
operations.title: Read a web page
operations.description: Open a web page (http or https) and read it as text. Only sites you may read can be opened. A page that moves to another site returns redirect_to instead of content. Long pages are cut at max_chars; continue with offset set to the returned next_offset.
